channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Age of History 3
item.description: Grand strategy wargame where the destiny of Civilizations rests in your hands - will they stand united under your leadership or fall divided in conflict? Journey through the entire saga of human civilization, from its earliest days to the futuristic era, crafting your legacy age by age.

item.title: Hello Kitty Island Adventure - Tea Garden
item.description: Mysterious invitations for the Tea Garden Ball have arrived. Nobody knows who's hosting… but everyone is invited! Help My Melody, Pochacco, Kuromi, Chococat, and more get ready for the most elegant event of the season.

item.title: Naheulbeuk's Dungeon Master
item.description: A dungeon in danger ! Build, manage, and defend your tower in the satirical heroic fantasy universe of Dungeon of Naheulbeuk. From a shaky establishment to an infamous lair!

item.title: Neon Abyss
item.description: Neon Abyss is a frantic, roguelite action-platformer where you run ‘n’ gun your way into the Abyss. Featuring unlimited item synergies and a unique dungeon evolution system, each run diversifies the experience and every choice alters the ruleset.

item.title: Screencheat
item.description: Screencheat is a ridiculous competitive split-screen first-person shooter where everyone is invisible, so players are forced to look at each other’s screens to win. Supporting both local and online multiplayer, combat in Screencheat is fast and furious with a wide variety of one-hit kill weapons.

item.title: The Dungeon Of Naheulbeuk: The Amulet Of Chaos
item.description: Step into the wacky heroic fantasy universe of the Dungeon of Naheulbeuk. Lead a team of unlikely and clumsy heroes in an epic and challenging tactical RPG. Live an adventure filled with humor, surprises and silly encounters.

item.title: X-Plane 12
item.description: Ultra-Realistic Flight Simulation

item.title: Asobi Premium
item.description: Unlock the full Asobi Premium experience: 1080p 60 fps HDR streaming, Upscaling (4k) , 120 fps frame generation, Ambient Lightspill, Zoom and Fill view modes, Low latency modes, On-screen lightbar halo, On-device haptics and full controller haptics, Manual bitrate control

item.title: Democracy 4
item.description: Democracy 4 lets you take the role of President / Prime minister, govern the country (choosing its policies, laws and other actions), and both transform the country as you see fit, while trying to retain enough popularity to get re-elected...

item.title: Denizen
item.description: Make a living for yourself in a city full of opportunity while you meet a variety of locals, explore unique locations, and work your way to the top in this open-world life simulator.

item.title: Fireside Feelings
item.description: Share your thoughts and discover those shared by others, in Fireside Feelings. Gather around the welcoming warmth of the campfire and take part in conversations between real people separated in space and time. Sometimes, we all need a good talk under the stars.

item.title: Glory To The Heroes™
item.description: Glory to the Heroes set in the Russian-Ukrainian war is an immersive PvPvE mil-sim providing perspective on the modern warfare with combined-arms combat and extensive elements of survival and immersion, where the action is happening in the accurately recreated real-world locations of actual battles

item.title: Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Don't Dry
item.description: My new adventure takes me from the end of the ’80s directly into the 21st century and wow, how the world has changed! While my view of the world and women from way back in the 1980s collides with modern reality, I’m all set to date my way across the modern world!

item.title: Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice
item.description: No obstacle will keep me away from my beloved, my Faith, not even the wild and untamed islands of Kalau’a. Those lovely island ladies can only distract me for so long as my heart’s compass only points in one direction - Faith!

item.title: Music for The Long Dark -- Volume Three
item.description: Original score for The Long Dark. Music for The Long Dark - Volume Three includes the entire soundtrack for WINTERMUTE Episode Four: "Fury, Then Silence", Episode Five: "The Light at the End of All Things", as well as all the ambient exploration music from Tales from the Far Territory.

item.title: PAPERHEAD
item.description: In the cute cardboard world, something went horribly wrong... Use the magical pencil, a good old shotgun, and various other weapons as well as the strength of your mighty boots, to uncover the dark truth and find out WHY WOULD CARDBOARD... BLEED?

item.title: Permafrost
item.description: Permafrost is a story-driven survival sandbox set in a frozen, post-apocalyptic world. Discover a vast lore-rich open world, alone or in co-op with up to 4 players. Explore, scavenge, craft, and build a network of shelters to outlast the cold.

item.title: Permafrost - Official Companion
item.description: Make the most of your journey through the frozen wasteland with the Permafrost: Official Companion!

item.title: The Pale Beyond
item.description: You didn’t ask to lead this expedition, but here you are. Stuck in the ice, Captain missing, miles from civilisation. Someone has to take charge. Manage your meagre resources, balance safety and morale, make the hard calls, and head in the only direction you can - through The Pale Beyond.

item.title: Tribe: Primitive Builder
item.description: Chill out as you explore the beautiful, realistic island of exiles. Gather resources, craft tools, construct buildings and settlements. Manage tribe and automate your gameplay. Discover 4 lands, a storyline and save the inhabitants of the island.

item.title: Truckful
item.description: Drive your pickup truck through seemingly peaceful countryside valleys, deliver much-needed goods to local townsfolk and unravel the small town mystery. Beware, the old forest is watching.

item.title: Pony Island
item.description: Pony Island is a suspense puzzle game in disguise. You are in limbo, trapped in a malevolent and malfunctioning arcade machine devised by the devil himself. It is not a game about ponies.

item.title: Gear.Club Unlimited 3 - Gear.Club Signature Pack
item.description: Get the Gear.Club Signature Pack and enjoy two exclusive liveries: the Honda S2000 GCU3 Edition and the BMW Z4 GCU Edition. Taking inspiration from Japanese culture, they will transform your cars into works of art!

item.title: Rotwood: Drakin Armoury Pack
item.description: A new weapon and playable species have landed in Rotwood! Join the Drakin and use their fabled Greatsword to conquer the woods and fight back against the vicious Drakinspawn.

item.title: MXGP 26 - Scrubdesignz Liveries
item.description: This DLC gives you access to 6 SCRUB Designz liveries for your bike.
